photos.c: This is thought to be the start of the Club '10' of 1926. Of the 11 starters, 9 finished. Winner was the smartly turned-out Bert Footer. (3rd from right) alongside of whom is the bespectacled Wally Bayliss who was to become our President, but probably retired from this race. Runner up to Footer was Micky Pyer (extreme left) who won in 1923 and 1924; with George Still (extreme right) 3rd. A.E. Smith (second from left) was 5th and J.G. Flatt (fourth from left) 6th.

Micky Pyer (extreme left) lines up at the start of the Belgrave 10 mile C.C. Championship in 1926. Having won the title in 1923 and 1924, this time he had to give way to his captain Bert Footer.
Left to right: A.D.Pyer, A.E.Smith, -, J.G.Flatt, -, -, -, -, H.E.Footer, W.L.Bayliss, G.Still.
